title: Joint Installment of a Held Payment Date and Cost-of-Living Increases — Income Annuities Joint Tiers
content:
For an installment held in suspense on an Ashgrove Income Annuities joint contract, the joint installment of the held payment date — the full joint amount of that date, before any survivor reduction — is fixed with regard to cost-of-living increases as follows:

1. **Increase after the held payment date.** Where the contract carries a cost-of-living rate and a cost-of-living increase took effect on a contract anniversary after the held payment date (an anniversary falling after that date and on or before today), the joint installment is the held installment as scheduled — the amount held.
2. **Increase between the death and the held payment date.** Where an anniversary increase took effect after the death and on or before the held payment date while the installment was held at the amount of the last installment issued to the annuitant, the joint installment is the held installment raised by the cost-of-living rate, rounded to the cent.
3. In any other case neither of these rules applies.

"The last installment issued to the annuitant" is the issued installment with the latest payment date whose payee is the annuitant; the installment "was held at" that amount when the amount held equals it.

### Cases (hypothetical; cost-of-living rate 3%; contract anniversary 15 June; death 10 May)

| Held payment date | Amount held | Last installment issued to the annuitant | Joint installment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 June, settled after 15 June | $2,000.00 | $2,000.00 | $2,000.00, as held (rule 1) |
| 1 July, settled before the next anniversary | $2,000.00 | $2,000.00 | $2,060.00, raised once (rule 2) |
| 1 July, settled before the next anniversary | $2,060.00 | $2,000.00 | Neither rule applies |
